subject: Animation
title: Glen Keane: Animating Emotion by Hand
description: Learn Glen Keane: Animating Emotion by Hand in one minute.

hook.text: Glen Keane animated Ariel, the Beast, Aladdin, and Tarzan — the most expressive Disney characters ever drawn.

buildup.text: Keane believed animation was about capturing the internal feeling of a character, not just how they moved.

discovery.text: His Beast transformation scene in Beauty and the Beast is considered the pinnacle of hand-drawn animation.

twist.text: Keane left Disney in 2012 as hand-drawn animation was being phased out in favor of computer graphics.

climax.text: His hand-drawn artistry defined the Disney Renaissance and proved animation could convey any human emotion.

punchline.text: One artist's pencil gave Disney's greatest characters their souls.

quiz.question: What made Glen Keane's animation work distinctive?
options: He pioneered CGI techniques at Disney
He focused on capturing internal feeling and emotion, creating the most expressive Disney characters

details.summary: Glen Keane animated some of Disney's most iconic characters — Ariel, the Beast, Aladdin, and Tarzan — with a visceral, emotional drawing style. His ability to convey deep feeling through pencil lines made him the greatest character animator of the Disney Renaissance.
details.whyItMatters: Keane proved that hand-drawn animation could convey raw human emotion as powerfully as any live-action performance. His work kept traditional animation artistically vital even as the industry shifted to computers.
takeaways: Keane animated Ariel, the Beast, Aladdin, Tarzan, and other Disney icons
His visceral drawing style conveyed emotion through movement and expression
He bridged traditional and digital animation throughout his career

faq.question: What made Glen Keane's animation special?
faq.answer: Keane drew with physical intensity, often standing at his desk with his whole body. His animation communicated muscle tension, weight, and emotion through line quality alone. The Beast's transformation scene required years of work and remains a hand-drawn masterpiece.

faq.question: Did Keane transition to digital animation?
faq.answer: Yes. After leaving Disney, Keane directed the VR short Dear Basketball with Kobe Bryant and the Netflix feature Over the Moon. He embraced digital tools while maintaining his commitment to emotional, expressive character animation.
